value.rationale: The exact worst-case DFA state complexity for square root restricted to permutation operands is a natural unanswered specialization of the well-studied state complexity operation. A factorial sharp bound for all n, small-state collapse, and optimal binary alphabet exhibit structural dependence on input reversibility; full group distinguishability, not just upper counting, is the substantive advance. It requires a nontrivial stabilizer lemma and is not a numerical slice or mere substitution.
